title: 사랑의 흔적
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal with heavy plate reverb. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A legato string section provides harmonic density with slow-moving pads. The percussion is minimal, consisting of a soft, muffled kick drum on the downbeats and a subtle shaker. The bass is a warm, sub-heavy synth pad that follows the root notes of the piano. The tempo is 72 BPM in the key of C major. The vocal delivery is breathy and intimate in the lower register, transitioning to a more resonant chest voice in the higher melodic peaks.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing sustained chords, soft synth pad]

[Verse 1]
[breathy baritone male vocals, heavy plate reverb]
빗소리가 천천히 내려온다
흰 감정은 언제나 같은 색
[legato strings enter]
해진 곳에서 뭔가 흐른다
누군가의 발이 내 위를 지나가고
나는 여기, 여기에서
[soft muffled kick drum enters]
비가 가벼웠을 때를 모른다
그 감각은 벌써 날
